classes.name: BBjGridSelectCellEvent
classes.docu: In BBj 19.20 and higher, this event is returned by [BBjAPI](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjapi/bbjapi.htm)().[getLastEvent](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjapi/bbjapi_getlastevent.htm)() when the program is executing callback code that the program has registered for the [ON_GRID_SELECT_CELL](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/events/cellchange_grid_notify_event.htm) event.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjevents/gridevents/BBjGridSelectCellEvent/BBjGridSelectCellEvent.htm)

methods.name: getSelectedCellCount
methods.docu: In BBj 19.20 and higher, this method returns the number of cells that are selected by the user if the grid is in multiple selection mode ([BBjGrid::setMultipleSelection](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setmultipleselection.htm)) and the Enhanced Selection Model is enabled using [BBjGrid::setEnhancedSelectionModelEnabled](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/BBjGrid_setEnhancedSelectionModelEnabled.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjevents/gridevents/BBjGridSelectCellEvent/BBjGridSelectCellEvent_getSelectedCellCount.htm)

methods.name: getSelectedCells
methods.docu: In BBj 19.20 and higher, this method returns a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm) containing the selected cells in a grid. If the grid is in multiple selection mode ([BBjGrid::setMultipleSelection](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/bbjgrid_setmultipleselection.htm)) and the Enhanced Selection Model is enabled using [BBjGrid::setEnhancedSelectionModelEnabled](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjgrid/cellselection/BBjGrid_setEnhancedSelectionModelEnabled.htm), then the BBjVector may contain multiple cells.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjevents/gridevents/BBjGridSelectCellEvent/BBjGridSelectCellEvent_getSelectedCells.htm)

classes.name: BBjInputMaskFormatErrorEvent
classes.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this event is returned by [BBjAPI](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjapi/bbjapi.htm)().[getLastEvent](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjapi/bbjapi_getlastevent.htm)() when the program encounters an error in the format of an Input mask. This can occur in one of two ways. First, the user has executed the restore command and has provided a restore string that is invalid for the control's output mask. Second, the SENDMSG() function was issued to set the restore string, but the string was not valid for the control's output mask.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjevents/bbjinputmaskformaterrorevent.htm)

classes.name: BBjLostFocusEvent
classes.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this event is returned by [BBjAPI](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjapi/bbjapi.htm)().[getLastEvent](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjapi/bbjapi_getlastevent.htm)() when the program is executing callback code that the program has registered for the [ON_LOST_FOCUS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjevents/events_correspondence_table.htm) event.

In BBj 12.00 and higher, this event returns the text value of the control when it lost focus.

In BBj 22.10 and higher, this event returns the boolean value of [client validation](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_ClientValidation/Interface_ClientValidation.htm) when the control lost focus.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjevents/BBjLostFocusEvent/bbjlostfocusevent.htm)

In BBj 6.00 and higher, if a program registered a callback for a [BBjNamespace](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjnamespace/bbjnamespace.htm)
variable by calling one of these methods:

[BBjNamespace::setCallbackForVariable](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjnamespace/bbjnamespace_setcallbackforvariable.htm)()
[BBjNamespace::setCallbackForVariableChange](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjnamespace/bbjnamespace_setcallbackforvariablechange.htm)()
[BBjNamespace::setCallbackForNamespace](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjnamespace/bbjnamespace_setcallbackfornamespace.htm)()
[BBjNamespace::setCallbackForNamespaceChange](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjnamespace/bbjnamespace_setcallbackfornamespacechange.htm)()

then, when the program is in the callback that was registered, a call
to [BBjAPI.getLastEvent](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjapi/bbjapi_getlastevent.htm)()
returns a BBjNamespaceEvent.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjevents/BBjNameSpaceEvent/bbjnamespaceevent.htm)

In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method calls [SysGuiEvent::getControl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjevents/BBjSysGuiEvent/bbjsysguievent_getcontrol.htm)()
and casts the return value to a [BBjDataAwareGrid](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/gridmethods/bbjdataawaregrid/BBjDataAwareGrid.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_BBjGridEvent/interface_bbjgridevent_getdataawaregrid.htm)
